experiments.scope: H1, H5 (proof.md Sections 5, 9, 13.1, 13.3 and Appendix D.6). Trials 0..5 run the counted online program on seed-drawn first blocks (two uniform words from SHAKE-256 of the seed per first block; real 38-step compressions) until a first block has a passing class (at most 64 first blocks), processing its first passing class completely (15,360..24,576 good pairs, 3 stage-1 and 60..96 stage-2 programs): the stage-3a decision of every lane is compared with the scalar definition (E16x = C16 + W0 + s0(W1) from the Step-2 equations), every passing lane's a0 with the class member, the hit list of all 48 W7 tests with the definition of F7, and 8 good pairs are checked against rows -4..15. Trials 6..13 run the 3 stage-1 programs and all nbat(ci) stage-2 programs of class COV[t - 6] = (0, 12, 24, 36, 1, 13, 25, 37)[t - 6] on a seed-drawn first block and compare all of its lanes with the scalar definition, so all four program shapes of the 48-class set (96, 84, 72 and 60 batches; 24 stage-1 and 624 stage-2 programs, 159,744 lanes) are executed. A trial returns M0||M1 and M0||M1' (128 bytes each) iff all its checks passed. Trials 14..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Full collisions: 0 by design (trials 0..5 return good pairs of rows -4..15 and trials 6..13 the first member of a class on a seed-drawn first block, not collisions). Mismatches: 0. Returned pairs: 14. Observations: first_blocks, w7_classes, classes_processed, good_pairs, prefilter_passes, row16_passes, counted_ops, units, filter_mismatches, cell_mismatches, lane_mismatches, pairs_cell_checked (trials 0..5); class_index, programs, lanes, prefilter_passes, lane_mismatches (trials 6..13). This tests the counted program, the bit-sliced decision of every lane of every stage-2 program run with its stage-1 program (H5), the memory-free F7 test and the Step-2 equations on seeded first blocks (H1); it does not test q3.

experiments.scope: H2 (the leading derivative section and proof.md Sections 6.1 and 7): an organizer-executed standard-library port of the direct mode-c lower-bound sampler. Trials 0..7 are independent SMC replicates seeded from SHAKE-256 of their organizer trial seeds: 32 particles uniform on the exact 160-word row-16 set; rows 17..21 use 64, 16, 256, 16, 16 proposals per particle. Each proposal imposes only the accepted E-cell and PQE bits, so E18=E17 is not forced and row 19 has no proposal-only relation set. Every bounded draw uses 256-bit rejection sampling. The tail uses 24 proposals per particle and one exact uniform index below 958,464, mapped by cumulative class sizes to a batch and lane. W23 is uniform in F23 with W7 kept iff in F7; E22[29]=0 and A/E differences are zero through row 37. Every success is rebuilt into a 38-step semi-free-start collision and must pass counted step3b. Trial 8 returns a pair iff the pooled mean of the eight linear estimates is at least 2^-101.0, no rebuild/check failed, and the cheap cumulative mapping self-check passed. Trials 9..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: The final round-3 preregistration SHA-256 93f68ef3ddc81c3bb85ac3d8f1dd175ab87d0b696e41e50987edb6c26caf2610 froze the source, eight-replicate sizes and pass rule before the final calibration. In 2,000 fresh identically configured C requests, 1,994 passed the -101.0 numerical threshold and six all-zero pools failed. The empirical pass rate was 0.997 and the one-sided 99% Clopper-Pearson lower bound was 0.992730288977. The earlier four-replicate attempt failed and is unused. Round 2 was cancelled and its results are also unused. C uses one integer-seeded xoshiro stream per request; Python uses one organizer-seeded SHAKE-256 stream per replicate. Both use exact finite-choice rejection draws, but C does not run Python's rebuild and counted step3b checks. Returned messages in trials 0..8 are 96-byte CV1||M1 semi-free-start witnesses, not ordinary full-message collisions, so organizer target recomputation reports zero full collisions by design. Observations are per-replicate estimates, successes and checks, plus the trial-8 pooled mean and mapping self-check. This experiment checks the port and witnesses; the numerical q3 claim comes only from the 20,000-replicate C lower-bound run and its conservative post hoc cluster sensitivity.
